Ep. 51 - The Softer Side of 70s Rock

podcast.body: This ethereally fuzzy song, written by Christine McVie, was chosen by Reprise Records as the lead single for Fleetwood Mac's 1975 self-titled album in America. It marked Fleetwood Mac's first entry into the American Top 40, peaking at number 20 on the Hot 100 in January 1976. "Over my head, got Fleetwood Mack into the top 40 in America for the very first time."
